definitions.explanation: Being completely focused on something to the exclusion of all else.

examples.japanese: ゲームに{夢中|むちゅう}になっている。
{彼|かれ}は{彼女|かのじょ}に{夢中|むちゅう}だ。
{夢中|むちゅう}で{走|はし}った。

notes:
Literally means "in a dream" ({夢|ゆめ} = dream, {中|ちゅう} = inside).

USAGE PATTERNS:
・〜に{夢中|むちゅう}になる (to become absorbed in ~)
・〜に{夢中|むちゅう}だ (to be crazy about ~)
・{夢中|むちゅう}で〜する (to do ~ frantically/absently)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ゲームに{夢中|むちゅう} (absorbed in games)
・{仕事|しごと}に{夢中|むちゅう} (absorbed in work)
・{恋|こい}に{夢中|むちゅう} (crazy in love)

NUANCE:
{夢中|むちゅう} can imply being so focused that one loses awareness of surroundings or time, similar to being in a trance or dreamlike state.
